description: Enterprise policy schema for multi-repo UX feature controls. Closes #724.

max_open_repos.description: Maximum number of simultaneously open repository workspaces per user session.

persistence_enabled.description: Enable per-repo session context persistence (files, terminals, tasks).

persistence_depth_days.description: Number of days to retain saved session snapshots per repository.

terminal_replay_enabled.description: Allow terminal command history replay during context restore. Off by default for safety.

telemetry_level.description: Level of navigation telemetry collection (switch latency, restore rates, error counts).

home_view_enabled.description: Enable the multi-repo home view with status cards and jump actions.

toolbar_tabs_enabled.description: Enable toolbar workspace tabs for quick repo switching.

favorites_max.description: Maximum number of pinned/favourite repositories per user.

recents_max.description: Number of recently accessed repositories to display.

snapshot_retention_limit_mb.description: Maximum MB of session snapshot storage per user across all repos.

feature_flags.description: Per-feature flag overrides for rollout control (#725). All flags default to the parent settings.
